This is so fucked up. AT&T will compete to match Google fibers speed in a city where they put it in, but not to all of their customers. Almost like AT&T doesn't give a fuck about you, and they just want you to keep paying them money for the same out-dated technology people have been using since I don't even fucking know when.

In my opinion the most infuriating part of google fiber is how when it moves into an area, all the other companies step it up. Why should it take google fiber moving in in the first place. Why not try to compete proactively, and give your customers in areas that don't have google fiber, google fiber speeds.

This is classic business. It tends toward redundancy or starvation. This is the same phenomenon that explains why all the networks generally have their commercials at the same time. In this case, this town is the programming to AT&T and Google, the rest of the nation has the commercials.

This is exactly what Google wanted to happen when they started rolling out Fiber.

They knew that there was no way that they could cover the entire US in fiber, they want other ISPs to raise speeds and drop prices because they want a world where everyone has fast and easy access to all of the content that they plan to provide.

I don't understand why it is so difficult for our government to spend money on the things that are obviously good for everyone. We should be spending now on fiber for everyone because it will improve business for everyone.
